global_claim_boundaries: Virtual evidence supports conditional utility of category-informed observation allocation under coverage/budget/safety constraints.
Do not call controlled RGB class markers natural open-vocabulary recognition.
The learning evidence V11.1 and posterior/planner evidence V35/V36 validate different implementations; no single current experiment jointly verifies all original neural modules.
Do not concatenate heterogeneous versions, task metrics, scene domains or confirmation/development samples into an improvement curve.
Replay validates reproducibility and is never a new independent sample.
Natural-device validation is deferred at user request; no virtual outcome is upgraded to a real-device claim.
figure_guidance: Use separate panels/axes for V11.1 delta-area score, V35/V36 terminal J5 and V4 AUC/V26-V27 outline J.
For V36 show every paired configuration including zero effects; present descriptive paired outcomes without fabricated error bars.
For V11.1 efficacy reuse recorded parent-context bootstrap intervals and show eight context effects; label intervals as context bootstrap and p-values as reported one-sided sign tests.
Retain stress null/negative effects and V35 h1 2cm feedback-negative contrast in the manuscript or supplementary material.
